namespace.description: The namespace this chart CREATES and installs its page objects into. It is the RBAC boundary the chart exists for — a group with no RoleBinding here cannot `list` the page roots, so the portal sidebar never shows them and the page body 403s on a deep link. The release itself stays wherever the composition is created; only the page objects live here.
namespace.title: namespace

dataNamespace.description: Namespace holding the BuilderPublish CRs, the git-provider LocalResources and the marketplace catalog ConfigMap — the DATA, not the pages.
dataNamespace.title: dataNamespace

readerGroups.description: Groups granted read of these pages in `namespace`. A group listed here sees the three Builder pages in the sidebar and can open it; a group absent cannot list the page roots, so the entry never renders. `devs` is deliberately NOT a default — keeping it out is the point of the split (#261).
readerGroups.title: readerGroups

previewSandbox.description: Where the builders keep drafts and page previews. MUST match the frontend chart's previewSandbox, which OWNS the namespace and its RBAC. This chart creates nothing there.
previewSandbox.title: previewSandbox

marketplace.description: Where these pages read the blueprint/operator catalog, read in `dataNamespace`. MUST match the portal chart's marketplace.source.
marketplace.title: marketplace
